story: Aiko and her husband Dan are very kind people. They live in a small house with their child. They help a poor girl and some children during Christmas.
title: A Kind Family
setting: A small, cozy house near a snowy street during winter.

characters.name: Aiko
characters.look: A kind woman with short black hair and a blue sweater.

characters.name: Dan
characters.look: A tall man with glasses and a brown coat.

characters.name: Finn

sentences.en: Dan is a kind husband to Aiko.
sentences.scene_prompt: Dan, a tall man with glasses, smiles at Aiko, a woman with short black hair.
